steps.note: Open the multi-stage event configuration screen.
Create separate Technical and RFQ stages for the stage-isolation check.
Configure the Technical stage before configuring the RFQ stage.
Apply a template to the Technical stage.
Add a line item so the RFQ configuration is usable.
Complete the Technical stage questionnaire requirements.
Assign the evaluator required for the Technical stage.
Move to the RFQ stage, where the event-specific terms will be added.
Apply a pricing template to the RFQ stage.
Open the RFQ stage's terms configuration.

args.goal: In the open Terms and Conditions editor, select a recent or previously used term if available, manually add the unique term text 'PRD-KBSRC-029 event-only term', optionally upload a document if the editor requires one, click Done, and stop on the RFQ configuration screen where the added term is listed in the event's T&C panel.

steps.note: Perform the terms-specific interaction that has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify the newly entered term is listed for the RFQ stage.
Move to the other stage in the same project.
Open the Technical stage's T&C panel for the isolation check.
Verify the RFQ-specific term is not shown on the Technical stage.
